description: This file implements parsers to convert Java legacy profiles into the profile.proto format, including functions for parsing CPU, heap, and contention profiles, as well as location and sample data.

methods.name: javaCPUProfile
methods.description: Creates a Profile object from CPU profile data, parsing samples and locations.

methods.name: parseJavaProfile
methods.description: Parses heapz or contentionz Java profile data into a Profile object.

methods.name: parseJavaHeader
methods.description: Parses header attributes from a Java profile and updates the Profile accordingly.

methods.name: parseJavaSamples
methods.description: Parses sample data from a Java profile and populates the Profile's samples and locations.

methods.name: parseJavaLocations
methods.description: Parses location information in a Java profile and updates the Profile's locations and functions.
